options.name: label
options.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby); also the data table caption.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (matrix size, lowest and highest value with their cells).

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format for cell labels, legend step ranges, tooltips, the data table, and the summary.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: Shared chart option; a heatmap has no series, so it has no effect.

options.name: columns
options.description: Column labels (x axis), in order (mirrored in RTL).

options.name: rows
options.description: Row labels (y axis), top to bottom.

options.name: values
options.description: values[row][column]: exactly one array per row and one value per column. null, NaN, and infinities are empty cells ("No value").

options.name: colorScale
options.description: { type?: 'sequential' | 'diverging' (default sequential), color?: 1-8 (sequential slot, default 1), negative?: 1-8 (default 2), positive?: 1-8 (default 1), midpoint?: number (diverging center, default 0), min?, max? (fixed domain; default the nice-rounded data extent), steps?: 3-9 (per side for diverging, default 5) }. Values outside a fixed domain use the first or last step.

options.name: xAxis
options.description: Column axis title (drawn below the plot).

options.name: yAxis
options.description: Row axis title (drawn beside the row labels); also the header of the data table's first column (default "Row").

options.name: theme
options.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

options.name: renderTooltip
options.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

options.name: syncGroup
options.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

options.name: legend
options.description: Legend listing every color step with its value range; auto and show both show it, hide removes it. Entries are not toggle buttons.

options.name: dataTable
options.description: Data table fallback with the exact matrix: behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

options.name: tooltip
options.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus (cell name and value).

options.name: patterns
options.description: Shared chart option (toggles aui-chart--patterns); heatmap cells and step swatches are not textured, so it has no visible effect.

options.name: height
options.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container. Cells share the plot evenly.

options.name: cellLabels
options.description: Values printed inside cells: auto and always print them where the formatted value fits (always skips cells that are too small); none prints no values.

options.name: locale
options.description: Number and message locale.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl mirrors the columns (first column at the right), puts the row labels on the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The plot (svg role="group"), named by the title and described by the summary.

properties.name: hiddenSeries
properties.description: Shared chart property; always empty for a heatmap.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Invalid options throw and keep the previous state. Keyboard focus stays on the same cell.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Shared chart method; a heatmap has no series, so it only re-renders.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, listeners, the resize observer, and the configuration subscription.

events.name: aui-point-click
events.detail: HeatmapPointClickDetail = ChartPointClickDetail: { seriesId: string | null; column: number; row: number; label: string; series: string; value: string; source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }
events.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart
cssClasses.description: Host (shared chart chrome).

cssClasses.name: aui-heatmap
cssClasses.description: Host modifier for this chart type.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--patterns
cssClasses.description: patterns option on (no visible effect on heatmap cells).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__header / __title / __title--hidden / __description
cssClasses.description: Title and description.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__legend / __legend-entry / __legend-item / __legend-label
cssClasses.description: Legend of color steps (static entries, not buttons).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__swatch
cssClasses.description: aria-hidden legend and tooltip key (step fill).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__body / __svg / __layer
cssClasses.description: Plot container (height from --aui-chart-height), SVG, and drawing layer.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__axis / __tick-label / __axis-title
cssClasses.description: Column and row labels and axis titles (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__series--c1 ... --c8
cssClasses.description: Palette slot classes; set --aui-chart-color from color-chart-<n>.

cssClasses.name: aui-heatmap__level--15 ... --100
cssClasses.description: Fill strength in steps of 5: the palette color mixed into color-surface at that percentage (sets --aui-heatmap-fill).

cssClasses.name: aui-heatmap__cells / __cell / __cell--empty
cssClasses.description: Cell group, focusable cells (also aui-chart__mark), and empty (null) cells.

cssClasses.name: aui-heatmap__labels
cssClasses.description: aria-hidden group of printed cell values (aui-chart__value-label).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__mark / __mark--active / __mark--hover
cssClasses.description: Focusable cell and its states (thicker color-text outline).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__value-label
cssClasses.description: Printed values with a surface-colored halo.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip / __tooltip-title / __tooltip-rows / __tooltip-row / __tooltip-label / __tooltip-value
cssClasses.description: Tooltip (aria-hidden; the focused cell carries the same text).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__empty
cssClasses.description: Empty state text (No data).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__summary
cssClasses.description: Hidden summary referenced by aria-describedby.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__data / __data--hidden / __table-toggle / __table-scroll / __table / __cell--numeric
cssClasses.description: Data table fallback.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--legend-bottom / --legend-start / --legend-end
cssClasses.description: theme.legendPosition (top is the default layout).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--no-grid / --gradient / --animate / --entering
cssClasses.description: theme.gridLines: false, theme.gradient, theme.animation (entering: the render that animates).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__annotations / __annotation-line / __annotation-band / __annotation-label / __annotation--<tone>
cssClasses.description: Annotations (aria-hidden), drawn under the marks.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__gradient / __gradient-stop
cssClasses.description: Gradient fills (theme.gradient).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip--custom
cssClasses.description: Tooltip content comes from renderTooltip.
